question_text: Atty. Reyes, a city legal officer, was found guilty of violating RA 6713 for accepting a bribe to expedite a business permit. The Ombudsman imposed a six-month suspension. Which of the following statements best describes the legal effect of this administrative penalty on Atty. Reyes's potential criminal liability for the same act?

options.text: The administrative penalty automatically bars any criminal prosecution for the same act under the principle of double jeopardy.
The administrative penalty does not preclude criminal prosecution because administrative and criminal proceedings are independent.
The administrative penalty must be fully served before any criminal case can be filed.
The administrative penalty reduces the criminal penalty by half.
